summary: Execution Environments are container images acting as Ansible control nodes, containing ansible-core, ansible-runner, Python and content dependencies, plus optional collections. The guide builds one with community.postgresql and psycopg2-binary.
questions: What is an Ansible Execution Environment?
What is inside an EE image?
Can I run Ansible from a container?

answer_card.title: What an Execution Environment contains
answer_card.answer_md:
An Execution Environment (EE) is a container image that works as an Ansible control node.

Standard contents: `ansible-core`, `ansible-runner`, Python, and content dependencies. It can also include collections (with their dependencies) and other custom components.
